name: monogram
description: A personal portfolio theme: a soft-clay single page with services, projects, a résumé, testimonials and a contact form, all edited as posts with internal tags.

name.description: Your full name. The first two initials make the monogram.

roles.description: What you do, separated by |. The hero rotates through them.

portrait.description: A portrait for the hero and the contact card.

skills.description: Tools you are best with, separated by |.

skill_levels.description: Skill:percent pairs for the résumé, separated by |.

availability.description: The line on the seal and the contact card. Empty hides it.

cv_url.description: A link to your CV (PDF). Empty hides the button.
